open_items: Full profile-bound duration/unit validation at designated semantic fields and coverage of additional valid ISO/UCUM representations remain open. Arbitrary preserved semantics are not declared fully duration-validated.

oracle.requirement_contract: Zeitdauern in strukturierten Semantikfeldern MÜSSEN als ISO-8601-Duration oder als Wert mit expliziter UCUM-kompatibler Einheit gespeichert werden.
oracle.scope: Explicit duration value helper: known UCUM time atoms and unsigned ISO designator forms; no complete UCUM expression engine, dimensional conversion or automatic validation of arbitrary semantic trees.

preconditions: Explicit invocation of the bounded duration value constructor; no duration inference from arbitrary natural-language or custom semantics.
steps: Read ISO designator durations or quantities with supported explicit UCUM time atoms; preserve values and reject unsupported/unitless forms.
